metadata.title: Industry Certification Bridge: Professional Standards
metadata.notes: Mapping legacy global industry certifications to the Mycelix knowledge mesh.

nodes.title: CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701 Mapping)
nodes.description: Core cybersecurity skills. Threats, attacks, and vulnerabilities; Architecture and design; Implementation; Operations and incident response; Governance, risk, and compliance.

nodes.title: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA Mapping)
nodes.description: Network fundamentals, IP connectivity, IP services, security fundamentals, and automation/programmability. Standard routing and switching protocols.

nodes.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate Mapping)
nodes.description: Designing resilient, high-performing, secure, and cost-optimized architectures. Mapping cloud primitives to decentralized infrastructure needs.

nodes.title: Google Data Analytics Certificate Mapping
nodes.description: Data cleaning, analysis, and visualization. Using SQL, R, and Tableau to extract insights. Mapping legacy data-pipelines to the Mycelial Oracle logic.

nodes.title: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900 Mapping)
nodes.description: Cloud concepts, Azure services, workloads, security, privacy, and support. Bridging enterprise cloud to sovereign node management.

edges.rationale: Mesh immunity training provides the practical foundation for Security+ threat domains.
Understanding P2P network topology helps in mastering standard IP connectivity.
Hardware security is a core domain of the CompTIA Security+ standard.
